name: Spherical Coordinate Volume Rendering
aliases: Spherical Coordinate Volume Rendering for Atmospheric Data
definition: A volume rendering method for planet-scaled atmospheric data that avoids accuracy loss from Cartesian-to-geodetic coordinate conversion by operating directly in spherical coordinates.
summary: Spherical Coordinate Volume Rendering is a ray casting technique that renders radar data directly in spherical coordinates, eliminating the need for preprocessing or resampling to a uniform Cartesian grid.
